# Research Question & Executive Summary

> **Research Question:** Where can someone find the best combination of authentic dining and live jazz in New Orleans, and which localized geographic area serves as the premier destination for this experience?

This analysis uses the Yelp Open Dataset to identify establishments that bridge musical performance and culinary quality across New Orleans. By evaluating category taxonomies, applying regular-expression text mining to customer Yelp reviews, performing spatial joins to official U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundaries, and comparing localized geographic systems, we isolate the premier jazz-dining spots across the city's ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTAs).

# 1. Setup & Environment

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(tidytext)
library(leaflet)
library(osmdata)
library(knitr)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
options(osmdata.user_agent = "New Orleans Jazz Map Quarto Project")
```

# 2. Large Data Management & Ingestion

```{r}
#| label: load-data
business <- readRDS("~/best-of-nola/nola_businesses.rds")
reviews  <- readRDS("~/best-of-nola/nola_reviews.rds")

glimpse(business)
glimpse(reviews)
```

# 3. Category Selection & Review Text-Mining

```{r}
#| label: category-analysis
biz_cats <- business %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(city, regex("New Orleans", ignore_case = TRUE)) | state == "LA",
    is_open == 1,
    !is.na(categories)
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(categories, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(categories = str_trim(categories))

music_categories <- c(
  "Jazz & Blues", "Music Venues", "Piano Bars", "Jazz Lounges", "Performing Arts"
)

food_categories <- c(
  "Restaurants", "Cajun/Creole", "Southern", "Seafood",
  "American (Traditional)", "American (New)", "Bistros",
  "Soul Food", "Breakfast & Brunch"
)

candidate_venues <- biz_cats %>%
  group_by(business_id, name, stars, review_count) %>%
  summarize(
    has_music_cat = any(categories %in% music_categories),
    has_food_cat  = any(categories %in% food_categories),
    all_categories = paste(unique(categories), collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(has_food_cat, has_music_cat, review_count >= 30)

cat("Identified", nrow(candidate_venues), "qualifying food & music venues.\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: text-mining-buzz
jazz_regex <- "\\b(jazz|brass band|trio|sax|saxophone|live music|live band)\\b"
food_regex <- "\\b(gumbo|jambalaya|etouffee|dinner|brunch|entree|po'boy|catfish|crawfish|chef)\\b"

food_music_reviews <- reviews %>%
  filter(business_id %in% candidate_venues$business_id) %>%
  mutate(
    mentions_jazz = str_detect(text, regex(jazz_regex, ignore_case = TRUE)),
    mentions_food = str_detect(text, regex(food_regex, ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  group_by(business_id) %>%
  summarize(
    total_reviews_analyzed = n(),
    jazz_mentions = sum(mentions_jazz),
    food_mentions = sum(mentions_food),
    both_mentions = sum(mentions_jazz & mentions_food),
    avg_stars_when_jazz_mentioned = mean(stars[mentions_jazz], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ranked_candidates <- candidate_venues %>%
  inner_join(food_music_reviews, by = "business_id") %>%
  mutate(
    jazz_share = jazz_mentions / total_reviews_analyzed,
    food_share = food_mentions / total_reviews_analyzed,
    score = (0.40 * stars) +
      (0.30 * coalesce(avg_stars_when_jazz_mentioned, stars)) +
      (0.30 * (log10(both_mentions + 1) / log10(max(both_mentions + 1))) * 5)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(score))

selected_category_businesses <- business %>%
  semi_join(ranked_candidates, by = "business_id") %>%
  left_join(
    ranked_candidates %>% select(business_id, score, jazz_mentions, both_mentions, all_categories),
    by = "business_id"
  )
```

# 4. Join Businesses to Reviews

```{r}
#| label: join-reviews
category_reviews <- reviews %>%
  semi_join(selected_category_businesses, by = "business_id") %>%
  mutate(review_date = as_date(date), review_year = year(review_date))

cat("Retained", nrow(category_reviews), "reviews across", nrow(selected_category_businesses), "selected venues.\n")
```

# 5. Spatial Boundary Verification & Physical Features

```{r}
#| label: spatial-audit
louisiana_places <- tigris::places(
  state = "LA", cb = TRUE, year = 2024, class = "sf"
)

restaurant_points <- selected_category_businesses %>%
  filter(!is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(louisiana_places))

restaurants_with_place <- restaurant_points %>%
  st_join(
    louisiana_places %>% select(GEOID, place_name = NAME),
    join = st_within,
    left = TRUE
  )

nola_official_selection <- restaurants_with_place %>%
  filter(place_name == "New Orleans")

nola_boundary <- louisiana_places %>% filter(NAME == "New Orleans")

orleans_water <- tigris::area_water(
  state = "LA", county = "Orleans", year = 2022, class = "sf"
)

cat("Confirmed", nrow(nola_official_selection), "venues within official New Orleans boundaries.\n")
```

# 6. Geographic System Comparison

```{r}
#| label: geographic-comparison
la_zctas <- tigris::zctas(state = "LA", year = 2010, class = "sf")

zcta_col_name <- names(la_zctas)[
  str_detect(names(la_zctas), regex("^(ZCTA5|GEOID)", ignore_case = TRUE))
][1]

la_zctas_clean <- la_zctas %>% select(zcta = all_of(zcta_col_name))

jazz_with_zcta <- nola_official_selection %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(la_zctas_clean)) %>%
  st_join(la_zctas_clean, join = st_within, left = TRUE)

orleans_tracts <- tigris::tracts(
  state = "LA", county = "Orleans", cb = TRUE, year = 2022, class = "sf"
)

jazz_with_tracts <- nola_official_selection %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(orleans_tracts)) %>%
  st_join(
    orleans_tracts %>% select(tract_geoid = GEOID, tract_name = NAMELSAD),
    join = st_within,
    left = TRUE
  )

zcta_counts <- jazz_with_zcta %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!is.na(zcta)) %>% count(zcta)
tract_counts <- jazz_with_tracts %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!is.na(tract_geoid)) %>% count(tract_geoid)

geo_comparison_table <- tibble(
  `Geographic system` = c("ZIP / ZCTA", "Census tract"),
  `Number of areas` = c(nrow(zcta_counts), nrow(tract_counts)),
  `Restaurants assigned` = c(sum(!is.na(jazz_with_zcta$zcta)), sum(!is.na(jazz_with_tracts$tract_geoid))),
  `Unmatched restaurants` = c(sum(is.na(jazz_with_zcta$zcta)), sum(is.na(jazz_with_tracts$tract_geoid))),
  `Smallest area count` = c(min(zcta_counts$n), min(tract_counts$n)),
  `Largest area count` = c(max(zcta_counts$n), max(tract_counts$n))
)

kable(geo_comparison_table, caption = "Comparison of Geographic Systems for New Orleans Jazz Venues")
```

# 7. Reviewer-Adjusted Rating Analysis

```{r}
#| label: reviewer-normalization
reviewer_activity <- category_reviews %>% count(user_id, name = "reviews_in_category")
eligible_reviewers <- reviewer_activity %>% filter(reviews_in_category >= 5)

reviewer_baselines <- category_reviews %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  summarize(reviewer_mean = mean(stars, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

category_reviews_adjusted <- category_reviews %>%
  left_join(reviewer_baselines, by = "user_id") %>%
  mutate(normalized_score = stars - reviewer_mean) %>%
  semi_join(eligible_reviewers, by = "user_id")

restaurant_reviewer_summary <- category_reviews_adjusted %>%
  group_by(business_id) %>%
  summarize(
    eligible_review_count = n(),
    avg_normalized_score = mean(normalized_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

review_comparison <- ranked_candidates %>%
  left_join(restaurant_reviewer_summary, by = "business_id") %>%
  filter(eligible_review_count >= 3) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_normalized_score))

kable(
  head(review_comparison %>% select(name, stars, eligible_review_count, avg_normalized_score), 10),
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Top Venues by Reviewer-Normalized Scores"
)
```

# 8. Localized Top Venues by Area

```{r}
#| label: top-by-area
best_jazz_by_area <- jazz_with_zcta %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(zcta)) %>%
  group_by(zcta) %>%
  arrange(desc(score), desc(review_count)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(business_id, zcta, name, stars, review_count, jazz_mentions, score, all_categories) %>%
  arrange(desc(score))

kable(
  best_jazz_by_area %>% select(zcta, name, stars, review_count, jazz_mentions, score),
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Premier Food & Jazz Venue in Each New Orleans ZCTA"
)
```

# 9. Optional OpenStreetMap Feature Data

The basemap supplies street names automatically. This optional section downloads streets and parks as separate `sf` layers so they can be turned on and off in the layer control.

```{r}
#| label: osm-features
#| cache: true
nola_bbox <- nola_boundary %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  st_bbox()

osm_roads <- tryCatch(
  opq(bbox = nola_bbox) %>%
    add_osm_feature(
      key = "highway",
      value = c("primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "residential"),
      value_exact = TRUE
    ) %>%
    osmdata_sf(),
  error = function(error) NULL
)

osm_parks <- tryCatch(
  opq(bbox = nola_bbox) %>%
    add_osm_feature(key = "leisure", value = "park", value_exact = TRUE) %>%
    osmdata_sf(),
  error = function(error) NULL
)

roads_4326 <- if (!is.null(osm_roads)) osm_roads$osm_lines else NULL
parks_4326 <- if (!is.null(osm_parks)) osm_parks$osm_polygons else NULL
```

# 10. Interactive Map with Free Street and Feature Layers

```{r}
#| label: interactive-map
best_venues_sf <- jazz_with_zcta %>%
  semi_join(best_jazz_by_area, by = c("zcta", "business_id"))

nola_zctas <- la_zctas_clean %>%
  st_filter(nola_boundary %>% st_transform(st_crs(la_zctas_clean)), .predicate = st_intersects)

nola_zctas_4326 <- st_transform(nola_zctas, 4326)
best_venues_4326 <- st_transform(best_venues_sf, 4326)
orleans_water_4326 <- st_transform(orleans_water, 4326)

score_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "plasma",
  domain = best_venues_4326$score
)

map <- leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$OpenStreetMap.Mapnik,
    group = "OpenStreetMap Streets"
  ) %>%
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$Esri.WorldStreetMap,
    group = "Esri Street Map"
  ) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = orleans_water_4326,
    fillColor = "#5d8aa8",
    fillOpacity = 0.45,
    stroke = FALSE,
    group = "Water Bodies (River & Canals)"
  ) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = nola_zctas_4326,
    color = "#555555",
    weight = 1.2,
    dashArray = "3",
    fillOpacity = 0.08,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#111111",
      fillOpacity = 0.18,
      bringToFront = FALSE
    ),
    label = ~paste("ZCTA:", zcta),
    group = "ZIP Boundaries"
  )

if (!is.null(parks_4326) && nrow(parks_4326) > 0) {
  map <- map %>% addPolygons(
    data = parks_4326,
    fillColor = "#78c679",
    fillOpacity = 0.35,
    color = "#238443",
    weight = 1,
    label = ~name,
    group = "OpenStreetMap Parks"
  )
}

if (!is.null(roads_4326) && nrow(roads_4326) > 0) {
  map <- map %>% addPolylines(
    data = roads_4326,
    color = "#777777",
    weight = 1.2,
    opacity = 0.7,
    label = ~name,
    group = "OpenStreetMap Streets"
  )
}

map %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = best_venues_4326,
    radius = ~rescale(review_count, to = c(7, 18)),
    fillColor = ~score_pal(score),
    color = "#111111",
    weight = 1.2,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~paste0(name, " (★ ", stars, " | Score: ", round(score, 2), ")"),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<div style='font-family:sans-serif;'>",
      "<h4 style='margin:0 0 4px 0;'>", name, "</h4>",
      "<b>ZIP Area:</b> ", zcta, "<br>",
      "<b>Rating:</b> ", stars, " ★<br>",
      "<b>Review Count:</b> ", review_count, "<br>",
      "<b>Jazz Mentions:</b> ", jazz_mentions, "<br>",
      "<b>Composite Score:</b> ", round(score, 2), "<br>",
      "<small><b>Categories:</b> ", all_categories, "</small>",
      "</div>"
    ),
    group = "Top Jazz Spots"
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = score_pal,
    values = best_venues_4326$score,
    title = "Composite Score",
    position = "bottomright"
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("OpenStreetMap Streets", "Esri Street Map"),
    overlayGroups = c(
      "Water Bodies (River & Canals)",
      "ZIP Boundaries",
      "OpenStreetMap Parks",
      "OpenStreetMap Streets",
      "Top Jazz Spots"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )
```
